items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I remember playing a picture called the Night Nurse, I think it was Colleen Moore

ctx.x: then you'd wait for the next call or something like that.

I remember playing a picture called the Night Nurse, I think it was Colleen Moore; it's pretty hard to remember because we played of them, in fact I worked in more silent pictures than I worked in talking pictures.
Maybe a little later on in our interview we will touch on the talking movies.
